### Multi-agent review

Use top-level PR comments for review and coordination.

Recommended prefixes:

- `[AGENT REVIEW]`
- `[QUESTION FOR OTHER AGENT]`
- `[RESPONSE]`
- `[IMPLEMENTATION NOTE]`
- `[AGENT VERIFICATION: PASS]`
- `[AGENT VERIFICATION: PASS WITH NOTES]`
- `[AGENT VERIFICATION: BLOCK]`

Scientific disagreements must be escalated to the human owner rather than silently resolved.
